cluster_name.description: Optional cluster name filter; use an empty string to query all clusters.

index_pattern.description: Index or data stream pattern to investigate (e.g. logs-app.payments-*, .ds-metrics-k8s-*). Required.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours).

configuration.query:
FROM .monitoring-es-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE metricset.name == "index"
| WHERE elasticsearch.index.name LIKE ?index_pattern
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR elasticsearch.cluster.name == ?cluster_name)
| STATS index_failed = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.indexing.index_failed), index_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.indexing.index_total), delete_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.indexing.delete_total) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(5 minutes, @timestamp), elasticsearch.cluster.name, elasticsearch.index.name
| WHERE index_failed > 0
| SORT bucket DESC, index_failed DESC
| LIMIT 50

description: Show indexing failure counts over time for the target index from the monitoring stream — filters to intervals where failures are non-zero.
